Replace the face, hairstyle, body proportions, clothes and accessories ONLY with the authored recipient slots below. Do not copy the reference person identity, baldness, face or black shirt. No added strand networks, stitching, decorative hardware or stubble. A no-beard slot means completely clean-shaven cheeks, jaw and upper lip. Maintain a visibly right-turned chest and asymmetric shoulders, never a frontal chest under a turned head. Full crown and both shoulders inside frame with plain background above all hair and accessories. Identity: Korean adult, male. Preserve every individual accessory and the authored body, including bust size. No text, labels, watermark or collage. Reference supplies method and shared camera, not recipient anatomy or garments. IMAGE1 is the sole DRAWING TECHNIQUE reference. IMAGE2 is CAMERA AND POSTURE ONLY: preserve its right-facing head/chest rotation, eye line, head scale and empty crown margin. Never copy IMAGE2 face, hair, clothes or its denser linework. Apply recipient slots and IMAGE1 painting method to IMAGE2 shared posture. Locked series camera: eye-level three-quarter medium close-up; identical camera elevation, azimuth, lens perspective, camera-to-subject distance, zoom and image-plane depth for every recipient. Full head, complete hair crown, both shoulders and upper chest visible. Keep the same face-center position, eye-line height, head-to-frame scale, crown background margin and chest-level bottom crop across the series. Do not move the camera, zoom or crop to suit a face, hairstyle, body, clothing or accessory; keep larger hair and ornaments inside the common framing without resizing the head. Locked series posture: upright neutral still pose, straight spine, level relaxed shoulders, no lean, head tilt, chin lift or chin tuck. Head, neck, shoulders and torso rotate together by the same fixed slight three-quarter turn toward viewer's right; the nose points toward the right image edge. Never combine a turned head with a frontal torso, turn only the neck, reverse direction, or vary the turn between recipients. Eyes look toward the camera with the same neutral gaze direction. Preserve individual facial and body geometry; no gesture or character-specific action.
